description: Local media helper service for webOS playback

services.name: space.nuvio.webos.service
services.description: Starts the local media runtime on demand and exposes health checks

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Start the local runtime on demand and report service health

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report the local HTTP endpoint status

commands.name: tracks
commands.description: Resolve embedded track metadata for a media URL

commands.name: subtitleText
commands.description: Resolve and convert an external subtitle document

commands.name: bitmapSubtitlePrepare
commands.description: Preload shared Matroska metadata for embedded bitmap subtitle tracks

commands.name: bitmapSubtitleWindow
commands.description: Extract a bounded bitmap subtitle window from an embedded Matroska track

commands.name: embeddedSubtitleTextWindow
commands.description: Extract a bounded VTT/ASS window from an embedded Matroska text subtitle track

commands.name: embeddedSubtitleTimeline
commands.description: Read the cue timeline for an embedded Matroska text subtitle track

commands.name: playbackServiceKeepAlive
commands.description: Keep the webOS companion service alive during playback

commands.name: playbackServiceKeepAliveStop
commands.description: Stop a playback service keep-alive subscription

commands.name: torrentCreate
commands.description: Create an EngineFS torrent stream on the local media runtime

commands.name: torrentStats
commands.description: Read EngineFS torrent stream stats from the local media runtime

commands.name: torrentRemove
commands.description: Remove an EngineFS torrent stream from the local media runtime

commands.name: enginefsDiagnostic
commands.description: Run an EngineFS torrent diagnostic against the local media runtime

commands.name: enginefsKeepAlive
commands.description: Keep the local EngineFS runtime active while playback is using it

commands.name: enginefsKeepAliveStop
commands.description: Stop an active EngineFS runtime keep-alive subscription

commands.name: mediaPlaybackKeepAlive
commands.description: Keep the local media runtime active while webOS proxy playback is using it

commands.name: mediaPlaybackKeepAliveStop
commands.description: Stop an active webOS proxy playback keep-alive subscription

commands.name: safeHttpProxy
commands.description: Proxy allowlisted account and cloud-library requests for legacy webOS

commands.name: audioTranscodeCreate
commands.description: Create a bounded local DTS audio conversion session

commands.name: audioTranscodeStop
commands.description: Stop a local audio conversion session
